entities.summary: General Mohamed Mediène, also known as Toufik (توفيق) is an Algerian intelligence officer who formerly served as head of the country's secret services, the Department of Intelligence and Security, from 1990 to 2015. He was described as the world's longest serving "intelligence chief".
